o: They were banned from the European Cup

ball.q: Which ex-Milan midfielder was sacked by Palermo in September 2013, called the 28th coach Zamparini fired in 11 years?

ball.sub: UEFA awarded Marseille the tie and banned Milan from Europe for a year.

ball.a: He confronted heckling Galaxy fans at half time
